question: 平均售价最高的5个商品分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与平均售价）
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
pred_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 5
